title: What Gene Sedric brought to the Waller group and how he joined
summary: Whitted lacked the selling power; when Sedric came in the group clicked, perhaps through the Apollo Theater with Slick Jones.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Well we were talking about Gene Sedric. And you're saying he's a very nice guy.
Aw, he was a heck of a -- he was a sweetheart, sweetheart of a guy.
How did he fit into the group as a whole? Does each guy have a sort of a place in the group, contribute a certain thing?

Yeah, now I told you Ben Whitted was our first clarinetist we had, and saxophone player. But Ben didn't have it. We couldn't have sold that group, we couldn't have. Victor or nobody else would have bought it, because we weren't offering anything, you know. It wasn't bad. The -- the thing, what they call it, sales power, that what made things move, I don't care what you name it, what you call it, anyway, that wasn't it.

But when Eugene Sedric came in, with us, boom! We had something. And the people saw it, they heard it, and they liked what they heard. And from the first to second, as we kept going, kept going, they liked what they heard, and it was great, and we moved up where we got into the money. And naturally now everybody was good.
Do you know what brought Sedric into the group?
I'm trying to --
I remember, I think we talked about this a little bit before. You weren't quite sure.

Yes, yes. Yes, I think so. I think it's the time there when we were in the theater, the Apollo Theater, and Eugene Sedric and Slick Jones was in the band, with Charlie Turner, or some group, is how we got -- I think this -- I think that's how it happened.
All three of them came in, then, at
the same time.

No, Slick Jones, and him. I was in the group. I think that's the way it happened. Anyway, when Fats heard him, because Sedric applied, I mean Sedric, as I told you, had been to Europe with -- uh, uh --
(Inaudible) okay?
Uh -- that's slipped my mind, because I think --
Well, we can find out.--
Yeah, they got a great band, though, great band, yeah.
-- who he went to Europe with.
I understand he's getting the band to group -- group again --
Oh, is he?
-- in Philadelphia, yeah, uh-huh.
